summary: 10.0.34.11 Enterprise Release - Complete 5-Screen Desktop Parity for Settings Studio, LiveOperationDialog Email Testing, and PascalCase Template Tokens
highlights: 1. Settings Screen 1 (Company & Billing): 4-column master grid, PAN, Industry, Business Type, FY Start, and dual application branding preview cards
2. Settings Screen 2 (Payment & Bank): 3-column commercial bank layout, max ₹5.00 reconciliation tolerance constraint with explanation card, and UPI QR code layout
3. Settings Screen 3 (Invoice & Delivery): Billing/shipping addresses, Place of Supply, Website, Currency, Timezone, Date/Time formats, and dual Logo & Signature preview cards

4. Settings Screen 4 & 5 (Email & Communication): SMTP credentials with password eye toggle, Google App Password setup guidance modal, signature image uploader, PascalCase template tokens, and LiveOperationDialog 3-stage email diagnostic test modal
5. Centralized Version Sync: Bumped version registry, DOM injectors, and cache-busting query strings to 10.0.34.11
